text: 创业板指半日涨超3%，全市场上涨个股超4800只，部分宽基ETF显著放量。 恒指半日涨0.61%，恒生科技指数涨2.85%，MINIMAX、地平线机器人涨超8%。 亚洲股市探底回升，韩国首尔综指盘中涨3%；国际油价跌3%。 铠侠本季利润指引逊预期，股价一度跌约15%。 中国10月RatingDog制造业PMI为52，连续11个月扩张，产出增速创六个月新高。 中国多只宽基ETF十月资金流入创纪录。 上周五沪深两市融资余额减少413.40亿元。
text_en: The ChiNext Index rose more than 3% in the morning session, with more than 4,800 stocks across the market gaining, and some broad-based ETFs saw significant increases in volume. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.61% in the morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 2.85%, and MINIMAX and Horizon Robotics rose more than 8%. Asian stocks rebounded from lows, with South Korea's KOSPI up 3% intraday; international oil prices fell 3%. Kioxia's profit guidance for this quarter missed expectations, and its shares fell about 15% at one point. China's October RatingDog manufacturing PMI was 52, expanding for an 11th consecutive month, with output growth hitting a six-month high. Multiple broad-based ETFs in China recorded record inflows in October. On Friday, margin financing balances in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets fell by RMB 41.34 billion.
